_readme: Portfolio content. Edit this file, push to main, and the site rebuilds itself on Vercel (scripts/build.mjs). Projects show in the order listed. Images live in /assets/work/<slug>/.

projects.name: Alpha Vital Elite IV
projects.summary: A physician-directed IV therapy practice led by Dr. Violeta Aronov, DO, a board-certified anesthesiologist.
projects.brief: Dr. Aronov wanted a site that feels as calm and clinical as her treatment room, puts the physician review front and center, and screens patients for safety before anyone books.
built: An editorial home page with a clinic-tour video and a scroll-driven infusion menu
A page for every infusion: what's in it, how long it takes, the price, and its own FAQ
A free online eligibility screening — contact details first, then yes/no safety questions — sent to HIPAA-compliant Jotform
A 40-answer FAQ and a research page with published references
The doctor's story, press coverage and a guided tour of the clinic
Ongoing Instagram, Google Business Profile and marketing management

shots.caption: Step one of the free eligibility screening — pick an infusion

projects.name: Cohen & Associates
projects.summary: A boutique tax, accounting and advisory firm, founded in 2004, that represents clients before the IRS and state authorities in all 50 states.
projects.brief: Cohen & Associates wanted a site that matches the personal, boutique service clients get in their Rego Park office — and sends every inquiry straight to the team.
built: A six-page site: home, services, about, team, FAQ and contact
A hero video of the team and the office
Services organized into three pillars: tax strategy, financial management and business advisory
An industries section for dentists, attorneys, physicians, real estate, business owners and high-net-worth clients
A searchable FAQ with topic filters
A contact form with a service picker, delivered straight to the firm's inbox through Formspree

shots.caption: How working with the firm runs

projects.name: Child & Family Psychological Services
projects.summary: Therapy, evaluations and family court services for children, teens, adults and families since 2007, led by Dr. Kristie Doheny, PsyD.
projects.brief: Parents often arrive worried and unsure what kind of help they need. The site had to feel warm, explain a long list of services in plain language, point people to the right office, and keep forensic referrals on their own line.
built: Eleven service guides, from child therapy to custody evaluations and neurofeedback
Clinician profiles with full bios
A tabbed FAQ across five topics, plus an insurance section
Four office cards — Hauppauge, Forest Hills, Patchogue and Mineola — with one-tap directions
A separate contact line for forensic and court-related referrals
A training institute section with the play-therapy workshop season and registration
Office and event structured data for local search

shots.caption: A tabbed FAQ across five topics

projects.name: Holistic Mental Health Services
projects.summary: Individual, couples and family therapy across four offices and telehealth statewide, founded by Dr. Kristie Doheny.
projects.brief: A sister practice to Child & Family with its own identity — calmer, focused on adults, and built around an $80 self-pay offer for daytime sessions.
built: An $80 self-pay offer with a live clock that shows whether today's booking window is open
Service guides for individual, couples and family therapy, CBT, EMDR, mindfulness, groups and neurofeedback
Therapy P.L.U.S., a dedicated LGBTQ+ affirming program
A founder profile and team directory
A filterable FAQ, crisis resources and four office cards with directions

shots.caption: The $80 offer, with a live booking-window clock

projects.name: Eviaesthetics
projects.summary: Dr. Evia A. Nano, MD's appointment-only aesthetics practice: injectables, skin treatments, medical weight management and IV therapy.
projects.brief: A private, by-appointment practice needs a site that feels discreet and high-end, yet still answers the two questions every new patient has: what does it cost, and how do I book?
built: A full treatment menu across ten categories, with published prices and pre- and post-care notes
Dedicated pages for IV therapy and hyperhidrosis treatment, each with its own FAQ
The physician's profile and the story of the practice
A consultation request form and click-to-call
A skincare section linked to the practice's AlumierMD shop

projects.name: Park City 3 & 4
projects.summary: A cooperative of six 14-story buildings in Rego Park, established in 1955 and managed by AKAM.
projects.brief: Replacing the co-op's old WordPress site with one place for everything residents need — forms, building rules, payments and amenities — that also shows off the grounds.
built: Nine online resident forms — alterations, garage waiting list, pet registration and more — delivered straight to management
Resident guides for ClickPay payments, moves and deliveries, insurance, house rules and sublets
Amenity pages for the pool, playground, garages, storage and laundry
A 48-photo gallery organized into buildings, interiors, amenities and grounds
A directory of all six buildings and a resident FAQ
